bias_targets.methodology: Literature survey categorizing how existing AI/ML research papers measure and optimize fairness specifications (e.g., equality of opportunity, demographic parity, group calibration) and analyze the risk of 'specification overfitting'.

Literature survey and case study analysis (e.g., examining predictive systems for cardiovascular disease in healthcare) evaluating how prior research applies fairness constraints across racial and ethnic subgroups and the subsequent impact on overall task performance.

A meta-analysis of 74 papers from major AI conferences to review how different methods formalize, evaluate, and attempt to improve high-level fairness and bias principles using concrete specification metrics and proxy datasets.
